subject: Deal desk clearance needed: Skyline Retail expansion — pricing exception and forecast impact
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>; Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@skyline-retail.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@skyline-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing exception request — Skyline Retail expansion (impact to Q3 forecast)

Team,

Quick summary: Skyline Retail is ready to sign an expansion SOW for an additional 600k ARR (annualized run-rate on contract) but they are asking for a 35% discount on list for the first 12 months as part of the pilot. If we mark this as a commit in the Q3 forecast, it materially moves our committed number (~+$600k). If we mark it as best-case, it stays in the pipeline but not commit.

Why urgent: procurement is pushing to close this week; they want final commercial terms and SOW. I attached the latest SOW (Skyline_SOW_v2.pdf) and a quick deal summary.

Asks:
- Deal desk (Karthik) — can you run the margin/CCS impact and advise on approval path for 35%? What documentation do you need?
- Finance (Laura/Rishi) — if deal desk conditionally approves, do we record as commit (signed conditional on SOW) or keep as best-case until signed? What guidance do you need to reflect forecast changes?
- Marissa — can you confirm timeline and whether sales manager signoff is in place, or if I should escalate to CRO?

Deal specifics (for quick visibility):
- Account: Skyline Retail
- Proposed ARR: $600,000 (post-discount)
- Requested discount: 35% for first 12 months, then list thereafter
- Proposed start date: 2026-09-01
- Deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/1907

Attachments: Skyline_SOW_v2.pdf, deal_summary.xlsx

Thanks — can we get initial answers by EOD today? Procurement is waiting on our position.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@skyline-retail.com>, Procurement <procurement@skyline-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing exception request — Skyline Retail expansion (impact to Q3 forecast)

On Mon, Aug 3, 2026 at 9:12 AM Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team,
> 
> Quick summary: Skyline Retail is ready to sign an expansion SOW for an additional 600k ARR ...

Thanks Alex — a few quick points from Deal Desk:

1) Need a margin estimate: please confirm list ARR (pre-discount) and the proposed total ARR post-discount. Your summary lists post-discount as 600k — what is the pre-discount ARR so we can compute the absolute dollar concession.
2) What product/tiers are included? (hosted API, dedicated, support level) This affects cost. Please call out any one-time services.
3) Approval path: 35% exceeds our standard field-level discount cap (25%). Anything above that requires Deal Desk + Finance + CRO signoff.
4) Evidence needed: Signed SOW (or marked draft with final price), margin calc in deal_summary.xlsx, and cost run-rate estimate (ops).

If you can get me the pre-discount list and confirm product SKUs by EOD I will run a formal clearance and get a conditional response. Otherwise, we should treat as best-case until sign-off is complete.

—Karthik
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing exception request — Skyline Retail expansion (impact to Q3 forecast)

Alex / team —

From a forecasting perspective, finance treats a deal as "commit" only after the following are in place: executed contract (or legally binding PO), clear billing start date, and revenue recognition criteria satisfied. If you have a signed SOW this week that matches the proposed economics, we can include it as commit for Q3. If the SOW is still draft and pricing is subject to approval, we should classify it as best-case until the SOW is executed.

If Deal Desk provides a conditional clearance (e.g., approval pending CRO signoff), we ask you to tag the forecast entry with the conditional note and estimated probability (e.g., 60%) so finance can reflect a weighted view in the reconciled pipeline.

Please provide:
- Confirmation whether procurement has provided a signed PO or just internal approval
- Billing start date and invoicing cadence
- Deal Summary with list price and final proposed ARR (pre- and post-discount)

I can run a quick recon update if we get the signed doc by Thursday morning; otherwise it will roll into best-case.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, FP&A
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing exception request — Skyline Retail expansion (impact to Q3 forecast)

Alex — tagging to escalate if needed.

If Skyline is truly ready to sign this week, escalate to CRO for final sign-off on the 35% concession. Karthik, can you confirm the minimum acceptable concession and any proposed commercial levers (e.g., 12-month term, prepayment, reference case) that we should require to mitigate the price concession? If CRO needs to step in I can coordinate a short Slack huddle and pull the packet together.

Alex — pls share the final pre-discount list price and confirm whether we can add reference case language into the SOW (required for the concession).

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@skyline-retail.com>, Procurement <procurement@skyline-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing exception request — Skyline Retail expansion (impact to Q3 forecast)

Alex — after reviewing the numbers in deal_summary.xlsx and running the margin calc, Deal Desk is prepared to grant a conditional clearance for a 35% concession with the following conditions:

1) Execution: Signed SOW required by 2026-08-06 with the price as stated. If not signed by then, clearance expires.
2) Commercial levers: 12-month term, upfront invoice for month 1, and a mutually agreed customer reference/press clause.
3) Internal approvals: CRO signoff required; please get Marissa to route CRO approval in the next 24 hours.
4) Finance tagging: Laura, please accept this as a conditional commit if all conditions are met; otherwise it should be treated as best-case.

If CRO signs off and SOW is executed by the 6th, finance can move this into committed ARR for Q3. If any condition fails, we revert to best-case. Attaching the deal summary we used: deal_summary.xlsx

—Karthik
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
